classification.rootCause: Perl reports 5 right, 2 wrong, 0 ignored, 0 exceptions; a matched Java v20251025 run reports 7 right, 0 wrong. The two wrong outer checks expect class="ignore">Not Executed and should be ignored< and class="ignore">Not Executed and should be ignored as well<. Java's nested response contains the expected scenario cells; Perl's HTTP-based nested request lacks the active FitNesse scenario context and shows ordinary unexecuted script rows with the not-run span. This is a PageDriver context-fidelity limitation, not an obsolete renderer expectation or Perl ignore-marker defect.
